owner_authorization: Owner approved the six-stage realism plan: begin with an AD200 Earth benchmark comparing evidence, a simple baseline and the current settlement model. Commit and push; continue beyond intermediate pushes.
supersedes: All warehouse/handling evidence NEXT instructions in older handoffs. No further truck/manual-handling research in this benchmark.
target: Roman regional settlement patterns around AD200. First deliverable is an honest conditional city-size development benchmark and evidence-coverage map from the already exposed Roman catalogue; full dated population, complete surveys and location forecasting remain separate unpassed tasks.
sources: Pinned official Hanson2016 Cities and Areas tables
evidence_audit: For every catalogue province retain AD150 and AD200-compatible occupation counts, unknown end dates, positive area availability, exact20/30ha flags, basis and inherited model-cohort exclusions. Areas has no dated phase column. A city occupation interval is not an AD200 extent measurement. Record this missing temporal qualification and absent independently documented survey footprint; never label catalogue availability survey completeness.
target_sets: All664 original model records (exact old control)
Original model records whose catalogue occupation interval contains AD200 under the old open-end convention
Strict exact Inhabited area subset of the AD200-compatible targets
AD200-compatible targets with an explicitly known end date, separately from open-ended records
comparison: M0: intercept-only log-area distribution, fitted only on the same original664-record outer training folds as the hierarchy. Current: refreshed-H hierarchy family using the already selected training-isolated outer coefficients, sigmas, phi and shift. This is the current model FAMILY evaluated with training isolation, not the all-data fitted release5 map evaluated on its own training targets.
folds: Preserve all four existing province-hash folds. They hold out provinces but are not contiguous geographic blocks and not new blind data. All 664 original records remain in the fixed training protocol; AD200 compatibility filters targets only, equally for both alternatives. No outcome-selected exclusions or refits of the hierarchy.
baseline: Training mean of log area; sigma from inner-held-out training log residual RMS, same nested protocol. No H, capital or location feature. Same existing area bounds and known-site geometry as current family; inherited bounds came from exposed development data and are not newly independent.
ensembles: First require exact replay of the hierarchy's five archived seed outputs. Then use 256 predeclared seeds1000..1255 for BOTH frozen alternatives, without retuning, to reduce five-draw Monte Carlo noise. Ensemble spread represents model assumptions, not calibrated archaeological measurement uncertainty.
scores: Log-area empirical CRPS, median log-area MAE/RMSE, median log bias, per-province and per-fold summaries, and mean generated total-area/reference ratio. Compute both pooled-target and equal-province means. Keep all provinces, including small samples, flagged n<5. No pass threshold or adoption decision chosen after viewing outcomes.
maps: Common catalogue sites and common bubble scale: source-conditioned extent, M0 ensemble median, hierarchy ensemble median. Whole-region map plus predeclared Aegyptus focus. Show all noneligible/dating/extent-basis limitations in the evidence companion. Maps condition on observed locations and supplied capital labels; they do not predict town count, location or total population.
checks: Exact raw-table hashes and fixed design joins; inherited Greek wall adjustments, defaults/exclusions preserved; exact old-five-seed control; separate scalar baseline means/inner dispersion and score review; fresh output identity; visual inspection. Historical live-publication differences resolve only to exact archived r5 baseline hashes; current published atlas is frozen and unchanged.
output: One benchmark report with evidence limitations, tables, before/after regional comparison figures, all-province results, explicit readiness/refusal gates and a concrete next discriminating test. No raw catalogue table redistribution.
exclusions: No new source pool/workbook, false blind claim, density or population inference from areas, chronology imputation, food/work/climate/route solve, parameter grid search, warehouse work, atlas/default adoption or modification of historical receipts.
programme_after_benchmark: Qualify genuinely dated regional population/settlement observations and simple spatial baselines
Constrain annual agriculture and transport with period evidence and explicit ranges
Rank the uncertainties that change settlement outcomes
Rebuild matching settlement/supply/reach/trade cohorts before atlas adoption
